bestBets.overview: On pace runners 2 and 7. THE LOCAL for Matthew Dale trialled very well at Randwick back in June. He hasn't been seen since but if fancied will be hard to beat in not an overly strong maiden. THE FRISKEE FLASH got well back and made very good ground on debut over the 1000 metres and looks suited getting to this distance. BOY BRUTUS resuming had a very wide trip on debut. He has trialled well for his return. I'M IRELAND looks to get an easy lead from barrier 3 and will be suited dropping back to the 1000 metres. JENNI MOO MOO has a place chance.

raceTips.comment: Jenni Moo Moo has shown enough in recent outings to suggest she is capable of playing a major role here, with her ability to settle close to the speed a definite advantage. The Friskee Flash has been racing consistently and looks suited by the expected race shape, with enough tactical speed to secure a favourable position and have every chance late. Our Miracle Girl possesses a useful turn of foot and should appreciate a genuine tempo, particularly if able to build momentum before the straight. I’m Ireland is another runner with the ability to make an impact, having shown glimpses of quality in previous preparations and possessing enough early speed to avoid being caught too far back.

SEA LEVEL was huge odds but ran very well on debut at Newcastle and he looks suited getting to the 1400 metres. AUSBRED ECLIPSE and ROMAN CITY have trialled fairly for their returns.

Ausbred Eclipse brings solid form credentials and looks capable of holding a prominent position from the draw, which could prove valuable when the pressure goes on.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1,2 and 6. Hard to go past PEACE BIRD who has won her past 3 runs all at this track. She has the pace to lead from barrier 3 and will be hard to run down but she does rise 5.5kgs from her last win. SPREAD THE LOVE will be fitter after a fair return this track. He has a very good 2nd up record so from barrier 4 will get his chance. YES SIREE has been freshened up since a strong win at Bathurst. STORMBRINGER who races well this track next best. This is a big class rise for MONTRESOR.

raceTips.comment: Peace Bird has continued to show promise and looks ready to produce another competitive performance, with a good turn of foot when saved for the right moment. Montresor is racing with plenty of consistency and should be able to put himself into the race without spending too much energy early. Stormbringer has the strength to make his presence felt and can keep finding under pressure, particularly if able to settle within striking range of the leaders. Spread The Love has enough ability to threaten the placings and should appreciate having runners around him, with his finishing effort likely to be his biggest asset when the field balances up.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 1,2,10 and 12. DAYLITE was very heavily backed and much too good when breaking through this track last start. He looks even better suited getting to the 1300 metres and he can measure up. The other last start maiden winner REMY'S BRO was also impressive winning at Moruya. He looks the leader from barrier 1 and can give a sight. COSTALIVIN had a wide trip when resuming and battled on well. Fitter now and from barrier 3 can be an improver. SEASMOKE outclassed at Rosehill last start has a place hope.

raceTips.comment: Wolf Island appeals as a strong contender on the quality of recent form and should get every opportunity to settle into a comfortable rhythm. Daylite has been competing well and possesses the tactical speed to secure a handy position, giving the runner every chance to be prominent when the pressure increases. Remy’s Bro has shown enough ability to suggest this company is within his capabilities, and a patient ride should allow him to conserve his energy for the closing stages. Glenn’s Legacy is capable of producing a sharp finishing burst and should not be underestimated, particularly if the race develops into a genuine test of stamina late.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners 5 and 12. PROPHET'S PROMISE racing really well looks the one to beat again in this. He only rises slightly in weight today after the 2kg claim. SNAP DECISION ran on very well 2nd up this track and distance to just miss. Even fitter now and from barrier 3 looks the main danger. MALINGA MISSILE a strong winner at Canberra last start has a very good record this track. LUNA BAY made some ground when resuming at Kembla Grange. Fitter now she has an excellent 2nd up record.

raceTips.comment: Prophet’s Promise looks a genuine winning chance on the strength of the overall form and should be able to settle in a position that allows for a clear run when the field straightens. Malinga Missile continues to show plenty of competitiveness and has enough speed to put himself within striking range, which should give him every opportunity to finish strongly. Luna Bay has been building a consistent profile and can stay in the contest for a long way, particularly if able to dictate or settle close to the speed. Beauer is another runner with the ability to feature prominently and should appreciate a genuine tempo, allowing the gelding to use his finishing strength when the race comes to hand.
